properties.decision_summary: `contested` is an annotation (history and explain packets), never a member of the current applicable view and never a change to the target's conflict state; oracle event counts are evaluated over the case's own record types only (principal/membership/observation/receipt excluded); C14 runs two arms (exchange-ref carrier and source-branch mode); `representations[]` lives on the admission-log projection, not the envelope; the admission log records a reason for every outcome; closed uncertainty windows are retained; attachment default 256 KiB
